claims: C1 people should have easy access to trustworthy safety-critical information from OpenAI's models

concepts.name: safety_critical_information
concepts.gloss: information whose accuracy and availability materially affect safety, such that acting on wrong or missing information could cause harm
concepts.inference: the clause names 'safety-critical information' as a class; its exact extension is not enumerated in this clause

concepts.name: trustworthy_information
concepts.gloss: information that is accurate, reliable, and from a source the model can stand behind
concepts.inference: the clause requires the information to be 'trustworthy'; what makes information trustworthy is not defined in this clause

concepts.name: easy_access
concepts.gloss: the information is presented in a way that is readily obtainable and understandable to the person seeking it, without unnecessary friction
concepts.inference: the clause requires 'easy access'; the concrete conditions of ease are not specified in this clause

concepts.name: model_provides_information
concepts.gloss: the model provides information I to a person P
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of people having access to information from models, so a relation between a model's provision and a person is presupposed

asserts.read_back: providing easy access to trustworthy safety-critical information % is preferred

closure.reason: the clause states a preference for easy access to trustworthy safety-critical information; it does not forbid or require any particular act, so silence leaves other acts permitted
